list: The official 55 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them (names, descriptions and grades via Exophase and PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026). Guides are our own words, built from the official descriptions; the game had not launched when this guide was written, so any step the description does not pin down is marked not yet verified in-game.

advice.name: Our own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Follow this guide's roadmap in order (story first, strands second, activities and collectibles next, clean-up last) and it will unlock on its own. If it does not pop, one trophy in the list below is still unchecked: use the tracker's filter to find it.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing and finish it — the trophy unlocks at the mission's end with no extra objective. It is the first story trophy and cannot be missed: just play through the intro. If you are replaying, the mission is available from the start of the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Chapters are story progress, not optional content, so keep playing the main missions in order. Check the in-game story menu if you are unsure which missions belong to the chapter.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Like the other chapter trophies it is unmissable as long as you play the story through. Do the chapter's named-mission trophies (Trust, Break the Bank) while you are in the chapter, not after.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Keep the story moving in order and this one takes care of itself. The chapter's named missions (Family Matters, DWNFALL) carry their own trophies, so watch for them as they come up.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so by the time it pops you are close to the end of the story. The chapter's named missions (Hi-Jacked, Snow Storm) have their own trophies.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the story's final mission to earn this gold. It is the natural end of Stage 1 of the roadmap: play Chapters 1–4 in order and the finale follows. Stock up on ammo and armour before starting it, and save beforehand — the exact finale is not pinned down by the official description, so treat it as a full mission, not a cutscene.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missableNote: Tied to one named mission, Breakfast Run. If the trophy does not pop when the mission ends, replay the mission before moving far past it.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. The trophy is tied to this one named mission, so do it during the story and check that it pops when the mission ends. If it does not, replay Breakfast Run from the mission menu before you move on — that is the only safe moment to recover it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missableNote: Tied to one named mission, The Cartel Heist. Replay the mission promptly if it does not pop.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Like the other named-mission trophies, it belongs to a single mission, so finish the heist and confirm the pop. If it fails to unlock, replay The Cartel Heist from the mission menu rather than carrying on and hoping it fixes itself.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missableNote: Tied to one named mission, Child's Play. Replay the mission promptly if it does not pop.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. The trophy is earned by finishing that one mission, so play it through to its end. If it does not, use mission replay to run Child's Play again before you get deep into the next chapter.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missableNote: Tied to one named mission, Headliners. Replay the mission promptly if it does not pop.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Finish the mission and the trophy should pop at its end. As with the other named-mission trophies, a replay of Headliners is the recovery if it does not — do it while the mission is still fresh in your replay list.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missableNote: Tied to one named mission, VCIA Takedown. Replay the mission promptly if it does not pop.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. The name points at the airport (VCIA), so expect the action there, and finish the mission to earn it. If it does not pop, replay VCIA Takedown from the mission menu before moving on.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missableNote: Tied to one named mission, Operation Savage Glory. Replay the mission promptly if it does not pop.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish it to the end and the trophy pops with the mission. If it does not, replay Operation Savage Glory promptly — it is the last of the named-mission trophies, so confirm it before the finale.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% in the in-game completion checklist. That checklist is wider than the trophy list: it counts story missions, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and exploration together, so this is a clean-up trophy, not a story one. Work through the other 53 trophies first, then open the completion stats and clear whatever categories are still short — that is what this gold is really asking for.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts in total — jumps, near misses, long airtime and the like all count toward the tally, which PSN tracks. The fastest honest way is to grind them deliberately after the story: pick a fast bike or car, a jump-heavy stretch of road, and repeat clean landings. Progress is cumulative across the whole game, so stunts you did during the story already count.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the game's 9 activity types at least once — one go at each is enough, you do not need to win or master any of them. The activities include the ones with their own trophies (shooting range, drone races, races, fishing, arcade, meditation, bowling) plus the rest the game lists. Tick them off in one session after the story and this pops quickly.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — PSN tracks the count, so you can see how many are left. Work through them weapon by weapon; gold needs speed and accuracy together, so learn each challenge's target pattern before going for time. If a challenge stalls, drop to its silver requirement first to learn the layout, then push for gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own race, so you need a win at every one, not 14 wins at one spot. Learn the course at each location first — drones handle differently from cars — then race for the win. The in-game map marks the race spots; clear them one by one.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Mix race types (street, off-road, boat, air if the game offers them) and work through the race list systematically, marking each win in the tracker. Pick the fastest vehicle class for each event and retry a race rather than grinding one you have already won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge — a head-to-head fishing contest, not just catching a fish. Fish with Cal, out-score him on the challenge's rules (bigger or more catches), and the trophy pops when you win. If you lose, challenge him again: it is repeatable, so keep your best rod and bait for the rematch.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish a full game at an arcade cabinet, start to end. Pick the shortest cabinet you find and play it through; you do not need a high score, just a completion. Arcades are marked on the map, so find one during free roam after the story.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableNote: The final mission of Andy's strand. Finish the whole strand; if the trophy does not pop, the strand's last mission is the one to replay.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's mission strand. Strands are chains of side missions for one character: keep taking Andy's jobs until the strand ends and its final mission pops this trophy. Do the whole strand in one stretch so you do not lose track of where it stands.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableNote: The final mission of Kenton's strand. Finish the whole strand; replay its last mission if the trophy does not pop.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's mission strand. Work through Kenton's jobs in order until the strand closes with its final mission — the name hints at a boat, so expect water. Finish the strand before the endgame so a missing pop can be fixed by replaying its last mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableNote: The final mission of Billy's strand. Finish the whole strand; replay its last mission if the trophy does not pop.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's mission strand. Take Billy's jobs as they appear and follow the strand to its end. The name suggests riding solo, so the finale is likely a lone run — finish it and the trophy pops with the strand's close.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida — the classic GTA side-character chains, marked on the map (usually with a question mark). Each strand is several missions for one stranger; finish 8 whole strands, not just 8 missions. The five named-character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) count toward this, so you only need three more beyond them.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableNote: The final mission of Randy's strand. Finish the whole strand; replay its last mission if the trophy does not pop.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's mission strand. Follow Randy's jobs through to the strand's end. The name points at supply runs, so expect deliveries and pickups along the way. Finish the strand in Stage 2 of the roadmap, before the late-game clean-up.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableNote: The final mission of Tyrone's strand. Finish the whole strand; replay its last mission if the trophy does not pop.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's mission strand. Take Tyrone's jobs as they come and see the strand through to its final mission. With this strand done, all five named-character strands are finished — a good moment to check Strangers & Freaks progress.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet scenic places marked in the world; sit and meditate at each one. Work through them region by region with the map open, and tick each off in the tracker as you go — 18 is a lot to hold in your head, and the count is what PSN tracks.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — a specific animal Bret asks you to track down, not any animal. Talk to Bret to start the hunt, follow the trail or clues he gives, and take the animal down cleanly. Bring a scoped rifle and approach quietly; a unique animal is a one-off, so save before the final approach.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — in shops, hideouts and out in the world — and each set needs every card in it. Pick three sets and hunt them systematically, region by region, using the in-game collection menu to see which cards are still missing. This is a grind trophy: leave it for Stage 4, after the story.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations. WAiNK It is the game's photo or check-in style action at marked spots — do it once per location and move on, since repeats at the same spot do not add to the count. Sweep the map district by district and tick locations off; 100 is the biggest location grind on the list, so pair it with exploration for The Goodtime State.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — the game's checklist of small feats across driving, shooting, exploration and activities. Open the challenges menu early and let it guide your play: many complete naturally during the story and the activity stages. For the last few, pick the easiest unfinished ones (short drives, simple stunts) rather than the hardest.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableNote: Needs your partner beside you during a 4-star escape. Do it while the story still puts you together — late game may leave you on your own.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. Do this during the story, while missions still put the two of you together — that is why it is flagged missable. Then break line of sight, stay out of the search cones, and wait for the stars to clear with your partner still with you. A quiet back road and a fast car make the escape far easier than downtown.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableNote: Needs your partner beside you for three shop robberies in a row. Do it while the story still puts you together.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level — the trick is keeping the heat, not losing it. Pick three shops close together on a quiet street, hit them in quick succession, and keep moving between them. Do it during the story while your partner is around; afterwards the chance may not come back.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — get in or spot 100 different vehicle models across Leonida. Variety is what counts, so drive everything you see: cars, bikes, trucks, boats and planes all add to the list. Cruise different districts and vehicle spawns (docks, airfields, highways) rather than driving the same car all game.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus — the game's slow-down aiming mode. Wait for a fight with a crowd of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it runs out. A busy shootout with enemies in the open is the place to try it; use a high-damage automatic weapon and aim for the closest targets first.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. Take a plane (or another aircraft) and leave the airport without a schedule: steal one from the runway or a hangar and get airborne. Expect the police to respond, so go in fast, take off quickly, and do not linger on the tarmac.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos — the tanks the military sends at high wanted levels. Get to a 5-star wanted level (or a mission that brings tanks out), then handle a Rhino: steal one, destroy one, or survive one, as the situation allows. The description is vague on purpose, so try the obvious first — take a Rhino down or take one over — and it should pop.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missableNote: One clean attempt: being spotted ruins it. Plan the robbery, go in quiet, and leave without raising the alarm.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a stealth robbery. Case the store first, go in quiet (masked, no alarms tripped, no witnesses), take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails: leave, let the heat die, and try again. Night and a quiet approach beat a loud one.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time — five separate bank jobs, with a clean getaway counting toward the total. Plan each one: a fast getaway car parked close, an escape route away from the police, and no lingering at the scene. Spread them across the map so you are not hitting the same bank twice.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — spot one, block or ram it to a stop, crack it open and take the cash, then get away before the police box you in. A quiet stretch of road and a fast car make the escape far easier than a busy intersection.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — every named district and region on the map. The count is what PSN tracks, so open the map and look for the areas you have not set foot in, then drive through each one. Pair this with the WAiNK It sweep (100 locations) and vehicle discovery: one long road trip can push all three forward at once.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one hit per gang, nine hits in total. Each gang runs its own operations around the map; find them, hit one per gang, and escape. Keep a checklist of which gangs you have hit so you do not rob the same gang's place twice and wonder why the count is stuck.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach with a view of the water, order a cocktail, and enjoy it — the trophy is a small moment, not a challenge. Do it in free roam after the story, when there is nothing chasing you.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass, GTA-style. Pick a showroom, get a car inside or aimed at it, and floor it through the front. It is a one-off stunt moment, so save first, then enjoy the noise.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — play a game of bowling there and finish it. The name of the alley is in the description, so find that specific alley on the map rather than any bowling lane. Play through the game to the end; a full game, not just one throw, is what counts.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — a moment with your partner that the public notices. The description gives no step to follow, so this is one to watch for during story and free-roam partner moments: do activities together, build the partnership, and the trophy should pop when a partnered moment lands publicly. If it has not popped by the endgame, revisit partner activities in free roam.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: Tied to choices in the story. PSN tracks a count toward 500 — make choices as they come and do not skip decision moments.
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — PSN tracks a count toward 500 for this one. Make choices whenever the story offers them (dialogue picks, approach picks, who to help) instead of skipping past decision moments. The count builds across the whole game, so play the story properly and decide at every prompt; it is flagged missable only because a skipped choice cannot be made twice.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: Needs a failed first try followed by a success. If you pass everything first time, look for a repeatable activity to fail once, then pass.
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — succeed at something on your second try after failing it once. The honest way: pick a repeatable activity or challenge, fail it deliberately, then pass it on the next attempt. It is flagged missable only because a perfect first-time run leaves nothing to retry — so if it has not popped by the endgame, fail something small on purpose, then win it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the game's odd, unexplained moment (a UFO-style sighting, a weird event, something out of place). These moments are usually tied to a place and a time, often at night or in a remote spot. Explore the odd corners of Leonida after the story — Mount Kalaga, the swamps, the desert roads — and keep an eye out; it pops when you see it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by — knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, swing a melee weapon from the car, and knock them over. Pick a quiet street with a lone pedestrian, keep your speed low so the swing connects, and do not use a gun — it has to be melee.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — take them to your contacts to wash them into clean money, and the total adds up across the game. Rob banks, vaults and armored trucks (trophies 40–41) and launder everything you take; $250,000 is a lot, so treat every heist as laundering income.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, cars, food, anything the shops sell. The total is cumulative, so normal play already pushes it up; in the endgame, buy the big-ticket items you have been putting off (a good car, weapon upgrades, outfits) until the counter crosses $100,000. It pairs naturally with the laundering trophy: wash money, then spend it.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought from the property market in-game; each one costs money, so save up during the story and buy them one by one. The in-game map or property app shows which ones you own — buy the cheapest first, keep the expensive ones for after the big heists, and check the count before you call this done.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find or steal 10 different vehicles, open the Scooter Bros app, and register each one to it. Variety helps — register a mix of cars, bikes and anything else the app accepts — and do it as you discover new vehicles for Whip It Good, so the two trophies move together.

roadmap.title: Play the story — Chapters 1–4 + finale
roadmap.text: Play the main missions in order. All 6 named-mission trophies live here, so confirm each one pops as its mission ends. Do Hot Together and Retail Therapy while your partner is beside you, and make every choice the story offers (Actions Speak Louder counts to 500).

roadmap.title: Finish every strand
roadmap.text: Clear the five named-character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) plus three more stranger strands for the silver, and hunt Bret's unique animal. Strands open as you explore, so keep the map's question marks cleared.

roadmap.title: Activities & skills
roadmap.text: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, win 20 races and 14 drone races, fish against Cal, bowl at Kolt & Associates, meditate at 18 spots, finish 50 challenges and 250 stunts. Try every activity type once for Master of None.

roadmap.title: Collect & explore Leonida
roadmap.text: Sweep the map region by region: 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 100 vehicles, 52 areas, 5 bank vaults, one illegal operation per gang, 8 garages, 10 Scooter Bros registrations, $250,000 laundered and $100,000 spent. One road trip can push several of these at once.

roadmap.title: Clean-up & platinum
roadmap.text: Mop up the one-off moments (VCIA departure, Rhinos, Ocean Beach cocktail, showroom smash, the strange sighting), fail-then-pass something for Bad Luck, then check the completion stats for 100% and watch the platinum pop.

notes: Missable flags are our reading of the official descriptions: a trophy is flagged when its description ties it to one named mission, one character's final mission, a partner moment, or a choice. The game had not launched when this guide was written — verify each flag in-game and replay a named mission promptly if its trophy does not pop. No trophy in the official list is online: the Online filter exists because the rules ask for it, and it correctly shows zero.
